title: Questions
body:
Group of fellow travellers working on scrum, agile, ai

which nodes should be human-in-the-loop? 

which priority model will ai scrum teams use? w-sjf, kano, 2x2, MoSCoW?

should we use several agents (coding agent, qa agent, etc) or just one agent that does everything?

which health signals should be tracked and evaluated for a health score?

DoD?

title: Chad's Workflow
body:
agent scrapes reddit for complaints

agent applies kano model to decide if complaint is basic, performance, delighter, indifferent, or reverse features.

Human confirms kano designation

Agent creates story

Human refines story

human pushes story to a coding agent

agent codes story

human checks output in staging

human examines PR (code review, baseline review, tests edge cases)

if human approves PR

    agent deploys

if human rejects pr

    sent back to coding agent with notes (refined)

        agent codes story
